campaigns.context: Over 400 Binance typosquat domains and typedream.app subpages spoof Ledger, Trezor, and Bybit via wallet-setup paths. Random-label bin* domains such as binancee2.com and biiusd.com form the bulk of the infrastructure alongside PaaS-hosted lure pages. Reporters phishunt_io and skocherhan flagged 403 IOCs between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: Crypto phishing targeting Binance, Ledger, Trezor and Bybit

campaigns.context: Six parent domains (jcd666.vip, qunaeer.com, mahuacm.com, pxb70.com, damaicn.cc, yijieguoji.com) each host dozens of subdomains cloning OKX, USDT, JD, and Alibaba platforms alongside gambling and romance-scam fronts. OKX-labeled subdomains (okx.*, okxa through okxe.*) appear across multiple parent domains, linking the clusters to a single Chinese-speaking operator. One reporter flagged all six parent domains on 2026-08-10.
campaigns.name: Chinese-speaking OKX and USDT fraud network on six domains

campaigns.context: Kimsuky (DPRK-linked APT) C2 spans dynv6.net, dynu.net, and dns.army DDNS alongside operator-registered .shop, .store, and .online domains such as dywkdfue.shop and nstlog.store. Auth-themed hostnames like kakao-user.login-accounts.dynu.net and update-themed endpoints like datupdatesourcetool.online characterise the activity. A loader (geniex_crav.zip) resolves its true C2 via DNS and XOR decryption - reporters flagged 88 IOCs targeting South Korean victims between 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-03.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky APT C2 infrastructure on DDNS and custom domains

campaigns.context: Multiple fake Zoom domains deliver RMM payloads via shared kit paths including /Windows/invite.php, /images/ZoomInstaller.msi, and /zoom/Windows across 80-plus domains. Payloads observed include ZoomWorkspace.exe, TraceRMM, and Agta Backup RMM signed with an EV certificate. Meeting and interview-themed domains suggest targeting of job seekers.
campaigns.name: Fake Zoom installer phishing via typosquat domains

campaigns.context: Multiple waves of Turkish-language .net domains impersonate Turkey's MHRS central physician appointment portal. Domain prefixes include hemen-, hmnis-, islem-, and sonuc- combined with appointment-system word fragments. One reporter flagged 200-plus fake domains targeting Turkish citizens seeking medical appointments on 2026-08-09.
campaigns.name: MHRS appointment phishing on hemen-prefixed .net domains

campaigns.context: Random three-letter paired subdomains under mybluehost.me abuse compromised hosting accounts to distribute Google-themed phishing lures at scale. The uniform two-to-three-level structure (e.g. alz.rgg.mybluehost.me) suggests automated provisioning by a single operator. One reporter flagged 60 IOCs on 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: Google phishing on compromised subdomains at mybluehost.me

Browsable directories expose staged files across DDNS domains. Two reporters flagged 59 IOCs between 2026-08-09 and 2026-09-03.

campaigns.context: Dozens of subdomains on posmasters.lk, a compromised domain, host Google-branded phishing pages with labels ranging from business names to project identifiers, suggesting automated provisioning on a hijacked site. campaigns.name: Google phishing on compromised subdomains at posmasters.lk

campaigns.context: DcRat, AsyncRAT, and XWorm C2 infrastructure spans bitmoon-themed domains (app-bitmoon.fun, trade-bitmoon.fun, verify-bitmoon.fun), a gleeze.com subdomain, DuckDNS nodes, and a GitHub repository.
